title: Pure Fossil
summary: Fossil Fusion and the Rock monsters that name it, with generic Links and staples. Fossil Fusion banishes its materials from either GY, so it fuses a Rock from your GY with a monster from the opponent's. The Fossil Fusions are Rock Fusions of Level 4, 6 or 8 depending on the second material's Level. Weathering Soldier searches Fossil Fusion or a card that names it when it hits the GY. Miracle Rupture mills a Rock and draws, and Specimen Inspection makes the opponent mill a monster you can use. Time Stream tributes a Fossil Fusion for one two Levels higher. The 2022 cards lead. Flint Cragger mills a Fossil Fusion Monster and burns, Shell Knight fetches a Level 8 Rock, and the Fossil Machines attack two or three times. Fossil Dyna Pachycephalo is Forbidden.
